hooks.name: note_play
hooks.neoforge: none (NeoForge has no such event; Bukkit's NotePlayEvent)

doc_summary: A note block is about to sound: `native_note_play(dimension, player, pos, instrument, note, cancel)` is asked when punched, used or powered. Set `cancel` to silence it; a canceled tuning interaction leaves the note unchanged. `player` is the acting server player when available. Bundles need "hooks": @API:note_play@.
